name: Florentine Lasagna Rolls
description: Lasagna noodles rolled with a spinach and ricotta cheese mixture, baked in a creamy Alfredo sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain and plunge into cold water.
In a medium saucepan, combine Alfredo sauce mix, milk, and butter. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly with a whisk.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Add red peppers and simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour half of the sauce into a greased large square baking dish.
Drain spinach, pressing out extra moisture. Combine with ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, eggs, and nutmeg.
Drain noodles and pat dry. Spread spinach mixture evenly over noodles. Roll up and place seam-down in the baking dish.
Top with remaining sauce. Cover and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until the sauce is bubbling.

keywords: lasagna rolls, Florentine, spinach, ricotta, Alfredo sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Spread 1½ cups of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan.
Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the cottage cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat with another layer of sauce, noodles, and the remaining cheeses.
Cover the top with sauce and cover tightly with heavy foil.
Set on a jelly roll pan and bake.

_similar.name: Garfield's Lasagna
_similar.description: A hearty layered lasagna with ground beef, cottage cheese, and mozzarella, perfect for a crowd.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can mushroom pieces and stems

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown the ground beef in a frying pan. Add onions and garlic; cook until tender.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, oregano, and salt. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook lasagna noodles as directed on the package. Rinse noodles in cold water using a colander.
Blend cottage cheese with approximately 2 cups of the mozzarella cheese.
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a greased 9x13 inch pan. Alternately layer 1/3 each of the noodles, sauce, and cheese mixture. Repeat 2 times until you have 3 layers.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: lasagna, ground beef, cottage cheese, mozzarella, layered pasta

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: ham casserole, potato casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine
